name: Azumo
description:
Based in San Francisco, we are an innovative software development comany helping organizations build intelligent software applications using the latest technologies in AI, NLP, data and cloud. We are passionate about solving problems for customers around the globe. You can learn more about us at Azumo.com


You'll discover cool people who love modern technologies and are in constant pursuit of professional growth and excellence.


Email us at people@azumo.com or chat with us at

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Generative AI and Agents
jobs.description:
Azumo builds and operates production AI systems for companies ranging from seed-stage startups to Meta. We are hiring an AI Engineer to own what those systems do once they are live: retrieval pipelines, tool-using agents, evaluation harnesses, and the guardrails that keep them dependable in front of real users. The role is fully remote across Latin America, aligned to your client's working day.

jobs.title: AI-Augmented Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Azumo builds and operates production AI systems for companies ranging from seed-stage startups to Meta. We are hiring Software Engineers to deliver product software in our clients' stacks, with coding agents as part of how the work gets done rather than as a side experiment. The role is fully remote across Latin America, aligned to your client's working day.

We do not hire by language. Azumo has shipped production software since 2016, and what we test for is whether you can take a problem into a codebase you did not write and leave it better, at a pace a client can plan around. Wh

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Latin America - Remote
jobs.description:
Azumo is looking for a Business Analyst to lead software development initiatives and personalized development projects.

You will collaborate cross-functionally with business and technical teams to ensure the successful delivery of high-quality solutions.

This is a hands-on, results-oriented role for someone who excels at translating complex business needs into actionable requirements, and who embraces AI tools as a force multiplier in their daily work

The position is FULLY REMOTE based in Latin America.
